_note: Base priority table (highest first) and escalation rules from spec 7A.8. Editable. Priority is dynamic: escalation rules raise a task's priority as its need becomes urgent.

BT_SCAN_ADV.name: BLE and Classic scanning and advertising
BT_SCAN_ADV.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES

escalation.text: A2DP becomes critical at 4 or more packets waiting, above Wi-Fi streaming and video conferencing and equal to isochronous audio.
escalation.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES

escalation.text: Any buffered stream (LE Audio unicast, Wi-Fi video streaming) rises when its buffer is nearly empty or full of waiting packets.
escalation.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES

escalation.text: BLE connection events rise as time since the last successful event approaches the supervision timeout, and become the highest when the next miss would drop the link.
escalation.label: STANDARD

escalation.text: Retry blocks inherit the original priority, raised by one level when the deadline is near. Retransmission windows of anchor tasks are a fallback and are not protected.
escalation.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES

anchorGiveUp.text: A low-cost anchor may give the air to a critical flexible block while consecutive misses are below the tolerated count and well before the supervision timeout.
